card_text: Curated hotels & villas for your wedding
intro_title: Rest in places as memorable as the day itself.
intro:
From cliffside suites with caldera views to discreet private villas tucked among olive groves, we hand-select accommodation that matches the mood of your wedding — intimate, celebratory, or somewhere in between.

Whether you need a romantic hideaway for two, connecting rooms for family, or an entire estate for your guests, our team coordinates availability, upgrades and logistics so everyone arrives settled and ready to celebrate.

tabs.label: FOR THE COUPLE
tabs.text: Boutique hotels and exclusive suites chosen for atmosphere, privacy and that first morning as newlyweds — with preferred rooms held whenever possible.

tabs.label: FOR YOUR GUESTS
tabs.text: Coordinated room blocks and nearby villas so friends and family stay close to the ceremony without the stress of booking separately.

card_text: The perfect wedding deserves the perfect arrival! From luxury wedding cars to minibuses, we ensure your transportation reflects the elegance of your ceremony.
intro_title: The perfect wedding deserves the perfect arrival!
intro:
For wedding transportation in Greece, our planning team works closely with Luxury Travel DMC, our parent company and the owner of one of the country's most advanced private transport fleets. Modern premium sedans, spacious minivans and comfortable minibuses are operated by professional, experienced drivers and selected to suit both the couple and their guests.

For something more distinctive, our long-standing network of trusted partners gives us access to an even wider choice of vehicles. From luxury wedding cars to specific models requested by the couple, we can source and decorate the right vehicle to complement the style of the wedding and ensure every journey feels as carefully planned as the ceremony itself.

tabs.label: FOR YOU
tabs.text: Make an entrance worth remembering. From sleek sedans and elegant limousines to glamorous convertibles, we'll match you with a wedding car that feels every bit as special as the day itself.

tabs.label: FOR YOUR GUESTS
tabs.text: Keep everyone together and in good spirits. Premium minivans, comfortable minibuses and spacious coaches make travelling between hotels, ceremony and reception easy for family, friends and even the biggest guest lists.

card_text: Professional photography for every moment of your wedding
intro_title: Every glance, vow and celebration — beautifully kept.
intro:
Our photographers and videographers know the light, the venues and the pace of a Greek wedding day. From quiet getting-ready moments to the last dance, they work discreetly so you can stay present while every detail is captured.

Choose stills, cinematic film, or a combined package — edited galleries and highlight films are delivered with the same care we bring to planning the day itself.

tabs.label: PHOTOGRAPHY
tabs.text: Full-day or ceremony-focused coverage with natural, editorial storytelling — portraits, guest candids and the landscapes that made Greece your destination.

tabs.label: VIDEOGRAPHY
tabs.text: Cinematic films that keep the voices, music and atmosphere of your wedding — from a short highlight reel to a full-length keepsake.

card_text: Bridal beauty styling for your ceremony and celebration
intro_title: Bridal beauty that feels like you — elevated for the day.
intro:
On your wedding day, makeup should feel effortless in person and flawless in photographs. We work with trusted bridal artists who understand Mediterranean light, outdoor ceremonies and long celebrations.

From classic elegance to soft modern glam, your look is planned around your dress, venue and schedule — with trials available where timing allows.

tabs.label: FOR THE BRIDE
tabs.text: Bridal makeup and optional hair styling timed to your ceremony, with touch-ups planned around portraits and the reception.

tabs.label: BRIDAL PARTY
tabs.text: Coordinated looks for mothers, bridesmaids and attendants so everyone feels polished without competing with the bride.

intro_title: Explore Greece together — before, after, or around the wedding.
intro:
A wedding in Greece is also an invitation to discover the country. We design private tours around your interests — history, food, beaches, wineries or quiet villages — timed so they complement your wedding schedule rather than compete with it.

Tours can be arranged for the couple alone, for close family, or as a shared experience for guests who want more than a hotel stay.

tabs.label: FOR COUPLES
tabs.text: Intimate half-day or full-day itineraries — sunset drives, local tastings, hidden beaches — planned around your ceremony and photos.

tabs.label: FOR GUESTS
tabs.text: Easy group outings that keep everyone entertained while you enjoy quiet time, with professional guides and comfortable transfers included.

intro_title: Private sea time for two — or your closest circle.
intro:
Arrive by sea, celebrate on deck, or steal a quiet afternoon between ceremony and reception. We arrange private yachts suited to your group size, destination and the feeling you want — romantic, celebratory or purely escapist.

Crew, catering and photography timing can all be coordinated with your wedding day so the experience feels like a natural chapter of the celebration.

card_text: Celebratory dining crafted for your wedding day
intro_title: From intimate dinners to joyful receptions.
intro:
Food and hospitality shape how guests remember the day. We arrange menus that honour local flavours while matching your style — from elegant plated dinners to generous Greek feasts under the stars.

Venue catering, private chefs and reception styling are coordinated with your ceremony timeline so service feels seamless from first toast to last dance.
